description: Read local PDFs without uploading. Classifies first, flags untrustworthy text, bounds output.

cmd.description: A directory the server may read PDFs from. Repeat for multiple directories. This is a security boundary, not a convenience: any path resolving outside these roots is refused, symlinks included. Grant the narrowest directory that works.
cmd.name: --root

name: io.github.vishalmeena2211/pdf-triage-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Minimum severity written to stderr. Defaults to info.
environmentVariables.name: PDF_TRIAGE_LOG_LEVEL

environmentVariables.description: Default truncation ceiling for tool responses, in characters. Guards the caller's context window. Defaults to 40000.
environmentVariables.name: PDF_TRIAGE_MAX_CHARS

environmentVariables.description: Largest PDF the server will read, in bytes. The parser buffers whole files rather than streaming. Defaults to 104857600 (100 MB).
environmentVariables.name: PDF_TRIAGE_MAX_FILE_BYTES

runtimeArguments.description: A directory the server may read PDFs from. Repeat for multiple directories. This is a security boundary, not a convenience: any path resolving outside these roots is refused, symlinks included. Grant the narrowest directory that works.
runtimeArguments.name: --root

title: PDF Triage
